blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Proposes On-Tap UCB Licenses for Credit Co-ops with ₹10,000 Crore Deposit Base. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Establishes a permanent regulatory pathway for large credit cooperative societies to convert into Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs).

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
Operational Track Record: Minimum 10 years operations required.
Capital Thresholds: Deposit base ≥ ₹10,000 crore, Net worth ≥ ₹300 crore (as of March 31).

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
Initial Eligibility: Restricted to societies registered under Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act 2002.
Prudential Conditions: CRAR (capital to risk-weighted assets ratio) ≥ 12%, Net NPA ≤ 3%, individual shareholding cap of 5%.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
